summary: Independently reproduced W6's narrow cache-root adapter defect at4925533. The actual S4 runner's {has,get,addresses} base is not enumerated by rootsKey(), so an output-producing calculation whose nested query reads an otherwise undeclared pixel Part can reuse an old result when pixels change and all declared inputs/constants/code/args remain equal. Current multi-course output poisoning remains unproven.

claimBoundary.accepted: Incomplete provider-root coverage for the concrete addresses-only adapter, demonstrated with persistent/shared Map cache across separate stores using instrumentedStore.
notEstablished: Any current six-course S4 result is wrong or cross-course-poisoned.
Every S4 calculation is vulnerable; explicit pixel inParts contribute their keys independently.
Any issue with content hashing itself: changed pixel Part content keys are distinct.
A numerical result from source alone establishes acceptance or scene geometry.

source.independentExtraction: git archive exact active ref fg/ and contracts/ into W4/pass2/source; git show exact files hashed independently; all three audited file identities match W6 source-identities

facts.fact: rootsKey enumerates provider Parts only when typeof b.keys==='function'; it never reads b.addresses.
Produced nonconstant call key includes declared input keys and rootsKey only if declared calls nonempty.
loadAttemptParts returns frozen {has,get,addresses}, passed unchanged as instrumentedStore base; lane outputs become constant roots.
instrumentedStore forwards base unchanged to createPartStore.

evidence.input: px.image.cropped={widthPx:1,heightPx:1,rgba:Uint8Array}; pixels[1,2,3,4] -> [9,9,9,9], same constant7 and codeSalt same-closure

cases.shape: keys() exists but omits pixel root

controls: Changing unrelated constant7->8 invalidates and produces36, confirming broad constant-root invalidation can incidentally separate existing course runs.
Explicit inParts:['px.image.cropped'] invalidates and produces36 even with addresses-only adapter.
Independent default caches per store recompute36; cross-run contamination needs a cache reused across those runs.

guardFixBoundary.owner: Platform fg/** and scripts/** ownership; runner adapter change needs owner allocation. No protected edits performed.
guardFixBoundary.minimum: Normalize every supported base inventory representation, including actual addresses adapter, into complete query-readable provider-root keys before allowing persistent cache hits for query-dependent output calculations. If inventory completeness is unsupported or unverified, fail closed on cache reuse for that call or require explicit read dependency declarations.
guardFixBoundary.counterexampleToWeakGuard: Merely checking keys() exists, or hashing every listed address, is insufficient: intentionally incomplete keys() in independent control still serves stale10. Contract must guarantee complete inventory; observed query reads can be checked against it or tracked directly.
guardFixBoundary.regression: Keep actual adapter and Map controls with same constants/different pixels. Add explicit-input/no-shared-cache/changed-constant controls and cold-versus-warm equality. Mutability/content-key memoization is a separate invariant, not fixed merely by inventory enumeration.
